title: code-template-tool template.config.json
description: Configuration for a code-template-tool (yuanhjty.code-template-tool) template folder.

name.description: Display name shown in the template picker.

allowExistingFolder.description: Allow generating into an already existing target folder.

variables.description: Template variables prompted to the user, in order.

defaultValue.description: Value used when the user leaves the prompt empty.

noTransformation.description: Use the raw user input without case transformation.

keepUpperCase.description: Keep uppercase words in the input as-is.
